:::{#def-adjusted-r-squared}
#### Adjusted coefficient of determination

Let a regression model with $\inputdim$ predictors and a constant term be fitted to $\nobs$ observations, with $\nobs > \inputdim + 1$.
The **adjusted coefficient of determination** of the [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) is

$$
R^2_{\text{adj}} \eqdef 1 - \frac{\text{RSS}(\est{\vparam}) / (\nobs - \inputdim - 1)}{\text{TSS} / (\nobs - 1)},
$$

one minus the [residual sum of squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-rss) per degree of freedom,
divided by the [total sum of squares](correlation-regression.qmd#def-tss) per degree of freedom.
A larger value is better.

Source: @james2021islr2e [section 6.1.3].
:::
